name: Static shot
summary: Lets a performance, a reveal inside the frame or a line of text carry the beat; reads as calm, observational, confident.

data.about: The camera does not move: same position, lens and framing from the first frame to the last.
data.avoid: Moovi films are never dead still: in a coded film prefer a slow push of 1-2 % unless the stillness is the point (a deadpan beat, a time-lapse).
